quote.exact_quote: Everyone else's posts were so helpful, so I wanted to review what I bought in case others find it helpful! The Kerastase in the picture is the tip of the iceberg! I spent more than I intended, but I’m happy with what I bought and luckily have the financial ability to afford this. As someone else experienced, this shopping has been a nice distraction from the loss of a family member. And I’ve recently lost a significant amount of weight and have been feeling better and want to extend that feeling to other parts of my appearance. I’m in my early 40s and have never really had a skincare routine and basically never wore makeup beyond a bold lip. My skin is fairly balanced but can be a bit on the dry side. Luckily I've never had acne issues and my skin has been pretty ok without any sort of routine. My skin is light and slightly cool-toned. I have puffy under eyes, dark circles, some hyperpigmentation by my eyes, and a few fine lines. My initial goal was to take care of the under-eye area without a full face of makeup, but I ended up going little further and bought some fun stuff too. Tools: Sephora Collection face brush set I didn’t own any face makeup brushes. I’ve only used these a couple of times so far, but they feel nice. I don’t have much makeup experience though, so my understanding of quality may be off. Makeup: Kosas color corrector in Magic I like the feel of this, but haven’t really mastered it yet. I got it for my dark circles. NARS mini Radiant Creamy Concealer in Cannelle L2.75 This also feels pretty nice. It creases a bit, but I think I’m making progress figuring out my skin prep and application process for it. Anastasia Beverly Hills Highlighting & Concealing Eyebrow Pro Pencil in Base 1 I got this to clean up the pigment around my lips. It is great. Goes on so smoothly and blends well. Ilia Super Serum Skin Tint SPF 40 Skincare Foundation in shade Balos I just bought this one in person on the recommendation from an employee. My request was something to even out my skin but feel like nothing at the same time. I told her that I’d tried a sample of the Saie Slip Tint and that felt ok and I’d have bought it except that it smelled terrible. I’ve only used this today so far, but I’m feeling pretty good about it. The color match is perfect. Haus Labs Color Fuse blush in Dragon Fruit Daze This was my fun and out there purchase and I LOVE it. It is such a pretty pink, goes on so nicely, and blends easily. Merit Solo Shadow Cream to Powder Soft Matte Eyeshade in shade Midnight I have this in the shade Nelson to use as eyeliner with a flat brush. It worked so well for this purpose, that I wanted to get this navy color to help make my blue eyes pop. This with my new Covergirl Ultramarine Black mascara looks great. As a side note, reviews of this say that it dries out and I can totally see how that happens. You need to really strongly twist it closed. Milk Makeup mini Hydro Grip setting spray I have nothing to compare this to since I’ve never used setting spray before. It smells a little like chlorine, but not so much that it is off-putting. I’ve been trying to mix it with concealer before applying to avoid creasing and I think I’ve been getting better at that. It also feels nice to spray on my face. Skincare: Clinique mini Take the Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover Hasn’t arrived yet. The Ordinary mini Glycolic Acid (restock) I use this to exfoliate sometimes and have been trying it on the KP on the back of my arms. I haven’t used it consistently enough yet to tell whether it will really help the KP. Dieux Forever Eye Mask Reusable patches Only used a couple of times so far, but they are nice. The size is good for my face and they stick to the face extremely well. I’ve been putting them over eye serum and leaving them for 20 minutes. I saw some reviews saying that the product was still on the patches when removed, but that hasn’t been the case for me. I think the serum really is absorbing well underneath these. The Ordinary Caffeine 5% + EGCG Brightening eye serum I’ve used this morning and night for a few days and feel like it has been helping with the puffiness. I haven’t noticed a change to dark circles or hyperpigmentation yet, but maybe it is too soon. It feels very nice when putting it on. Biossance mini Marine Algae eye cream I had a sample of this and immediately liked the feel better than the Kiehl’s avocado eye cream that I also had a sample of. Effectiveness is still to be determined. The Ordinary Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% in Vitamin F I’ve only used this a couple of times so I can’t really judge yet. The Ordinary Granactive Retinoid* 2% Emulsion Hasn’t arrived yet Eadem lip balm in clear The metal applicator feels nice, but I prefer to squeeze balms like this out and then apply with a finger. Trying to use the applicator on anything like this (Ole, Jack Black, etc) feels messy to me. The staying power on this is impressive, but I’ve only used it for one day so I’m not sure how it will fall in my lip balm rankings. Hair: My hair has always been my thing. It is color-treated with a little gray coverage, mid-back length on its way back to tailbone length, wavy, and not really fine or thick but I have a lot of it. I love a big, bouncy blowout and do that with my Dyson Airwrap after washing my hair twice a week. Drybar Seltzer Spritz flexible hold hairspray (restock) I’ve tried several other flexible hold hairsprays and they all smelled so terrible to me. This one smells much better and holds well without feeling like anything. Amika Dream Routine I have the Kerastase overnight treatment, but it too quickly felt like buildup on my hair. I think that my hair doesn’t like that much protein in a leave-in. I’ve used this Amika version twice now and like it better so far. Kerastase Gloss Absolu line I love basically all Kerastase products (aside from the overnight serum) and am all about the big, bouncy, shiny blowouts so I had to try this line. I got the mini sizes. I’ve only used it all once, but love the results. This blowout is definitely voluminous and bouncy. It does seem to have more oomph than my typical routine. My blowouts typically last a few days although the volume decreases. I'm looking forward to seeing how well this holds. I may buy the full sizes after trying it a few more times. Luckily Kerastase has 20% off pretty often on their website. Shampoo Smells nice (better than the Genesis line) but the scent is pretty light for a Kerastase product. I used this for my second wash and it was nice. Conditioner Thinner than I expected, but it worked into my hair nicely. Didn’t feel as slick after rinsing as other conditioners or masks like the Genesis mask, Superfood mask, or Redken Color Gloss conditioner. Because of that, I was concerned that detangling would be more difficult since my hair needs a lot of slip. But that worked out fine. Overall not bad. Anti-frizz spray Pureology Color Fanatic leave-in is my HG. This seems thicker than that, but detangled well. I’ll need to use it more to determine whether it will dethrone the Pureology. Hair oil This smells lovely. As I applied it, it felt a little lighter than the Elixir Ultime. I’m not sure if it gave me any more shine than normal and the dropper is less convenient to use than the pump bottle. But overall it seems nice. This is probably not a repurchase item for me, but I'll enjoy it while it lasts.

quote.exact_quote: One of those few, rare things where it's worth the hype--and a completely reasonable price. No more disposable undereye masks. Don't bother with the knock-offs. For $25, this is absolutely worth getting. Pop 'em in the fridge or freezer, use your own cream, let them sit on your face while in a camera-off zoom meeting or watching bravo and or when you're halfway down the street walking the dog and realize you forgot to take them off. They stick like you wouldn't believe and a quick rinse afterwards will clean any residue from serums/creams. By far one of the best skincare purchases I've made this year.
